SELECT countries.countryid, countries.countryname 
FROM countries 
JOIN car_makers ON countries.country = car_makers.country 
LEFT JOIN model_list ON car_makers.id = model_list.maker 
WHERE countries.countryid IN (
    SELECT countryid 
    FROM (
        SELECT countryid, COUNT(DISTINCT maker) AS maker_count 
        FROM car_makers 
        GROUP BY countryid 
        HAVING maker_count > 3
    ) 
    UNION 
    SELECT countryid 
    FROM car_makers 
    JOIN model_list ON car_makers.id = model_list.maker 
    WHERE model_list.model = 'fiat'
)
